rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A comprehensive Telegram MCP server built on Telethon that provides full client capabilities beyond basic bot API access. Supports multiple authentication methods including QR code scanning and phone number verification across 177 countries. Features a web dashboard interface for visual management, scheduled messaging with AI-enhanced message polishing, batch sending with deduplication, and per-account proxy configuration. Suitable for automated messaging workflows, multi-account management, and Telegram operations requiring MTProto protocol access.
